catalog_listings_featured_position.name: catalog_listings_featured_position
catalog_listings_featured_position.value: "catalog_listings"."featured_position" is null or ("catalog_listings"."featured_position" between 1 and 3 and "catalog_listings"."status" = 'approved')

routes_price.name: routes_price
routes_price.value: ("routes"."price_minor" is null and "routes"."currency" is null) or ("routes"."price_minor" >= 0 and "routes"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
